item.text:
The module provides order helpers to:

- Calculate totals from item price × quantity.
- Apply `SAVE10` or `SAVE20` discounts.
- Calculate an average item price.
- Format an order as text with a two-decimal total.

Bugs:

- [orders.js:5](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-xV8mdp/test/orders.js:5) has an off-by-one error: `i <= items.length` should be `i < items.length`. It accesses `items[items.length]`, causing a `TypeError` for every input, including an empty array. This also breaks `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder`.
- [orders.js:20](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-xV8mdp/test/orders.js:20) would divide by zero for an empty array once the loop is fixed, producing `NaN`.
- “Average item price” is arguably miscomputed: it divides the total order value by the number of line items, not by the total quantity. If quantities can exceed one, that is an average line total rather than an average unit price.
